sourceGuard.policy: Exact source-only sentence/8gram index; foreign synthetic inputs fall back to unchanged target
sourceGuard.proof: Only input keys are removed; added identity keys were already indexed as immutable clean keys. All foreign inputs sharing any clean key and both sides of noise/noise collisions are rejected. A fresh full gate remains mandatory.
